## Evidence Harness SLOs

Rolling horizon: 30 days. Alert evaluation window: 1 hour. Prototype evidence is advisory only.

content.query: requests | where timestamp > ago(30d) | where url has '/api/v1/evidence/' or url has '/api/healthz/evidence' | summarize availability_pct = 100.0 * countif(success == true) / count(), sample_count = count()
content.title: Availability SLO — target >= 99.5%

content.query: requests | where timestamp > ago(30d) | where name has '/api/v1/evidence/scenarios/' and name has '/replay' | summarize replay_success_pct = 100.0 * countif(success == true) / count(), sample_count = count()
content.title: Replay success SLO — target >= 98%

content.query: customEvents | where timestamp > ago(30d) | where name == 'evidence.signal.persisted' | extend occurred_at = todatetime(customDimensions['occurred_at']) | extend freshness_seconds = datetime_diff('second', timestamp, occurred_at) | summarize p95_freshness_seconds = percentile(freshness_seconds, 95), sample_count = count()
content.title: Evidence freshness SLO — target <= 60 seconds

content.query: customEvents | where timestamp > ago(1h) | where name in ('evidence.audit.mirror.failed', 'evidence.audit.mirror.lag') | summarize failures = countif(name == 'evidence.audit.mirror.failed'), max_lag_seconds = max(todouble(customDimensions['lag_seconds']))
content.title: Immutable audit mirror health
